question_summary: Subcontractor requests approval to substitute PVC piping for the specified cast-iron roof drain leader per Section 22 14 00 before placing material order.
proposed_solution: Use PVC alternate in lieu of cast-iron roof drain leader; submitter states this is cost-neutral and will not affect domestic water pressure test date.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: The request concerns a substitution of plumbing piping material specified in Division 22, requiring plumbing engineering review and approval.
